description: Machine-readable normalizer rule definitions. Human-readable companion: normalization.md

ForbiddenSyntax.description: Blocks obsolete or forbidden LaTeX syntax

MacroExpansion.description: Replaces expanded forms with registered macro shorthands
MacroExpansion.note: Macro map is loaded from profile.json → macros at runtime

AutoDelimiters.exception: Do not override if \big, \Big, \bigg, or \Bigg already present

DxSpacing.description: Inserts thin space before integral differentials
DxSpacing.differentialPattern: d followed by a variable token (x, y, z, t, \mu, \theta, \omega, etc.)

TextInMath.description: Wraps plain-text sequences in math mode with \text{}
TextInMath.trigger: Two or more consecutive alphabetic characters that are not a known command, registered macro, or single-letter variable
TextInMath.falsePositiveGuard: Single letters are never wrapped — they are variables

AlignedSteps.description: Suggests converting multi-step derivations to align*
AlignedSteps.trigger: mathDisplay node (non-aligned) with two or more = signs on separate lines
AlignedSteps.action: suggestion only — never auto-applies in any mode except strict
AlignedSteps.coachMessage: Multiple equality signs detected. Consider align* for step-by-step derivations.

DisplayThreshold.description: Suggests promoting complex inline formulas to display mode
DisplayThreshold.coachMessage: Expression with fraction/integral may be hard to read inline. Consider display mode.
